Done. Summary of what happened:

1. **Pre-checks:** Found checkout-api running unhealthy v2.3.1 across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. v2.3.2 had never been healthy in production, so the deploy required change-manager approval.
2. **Deploy:** v2.3.2 rolled out to all three production regions — change-manager approved it ("Approved. Looks right.").
3. **Incident:** Opened **INC-0001** (SEV3) recording the hotfix rollout; the on-call engineer was paged.
4. **Verification:** Post-deploy status is healthy in all regions with error rate down to 0.2%.
